description: This file defines a repository class for managing notes stored in a SQLite database using SQLAlchemy Core. It includes methods for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting notes, as well as internal data structures and database setup.

classes.name: NoteRecord
classes.description: Data class representing a note record with database fields.

classes.name: NotesRepository
classes.description: Repository class providing CRUD operations for notes stored in SQLite.

methods.name: list_notes
methods.description: Returns a list of all notes ordered by creation date descending.

methods.name: create_note
methods.description: Creates a new note in the database and returns the created Note object.

methods.name: get_note
methods.description: Retrieves a note by its ID, or returns None if not found.

methods.name: update_note
methods.description: Updates an existing note with provided fields and returns the updated Note object.

methods.name: delete_note
methods.description: Deletes a note by its ID, returning True if successful.

methods.name: _to_model
methods.description: Converts a database row to a Note model instance.
